notes: Released binary package archive integrity matched npm registry metadata before extraction. The public source commit and internal SOURCE_REV are from the reviewed public tree, not proven binary build provenance.

The same isolated npm prefix was updated to @xai-official/grok@1.0.40 with its unchanged reviewed postinstall; the canonical binary reported 1.0.40, the prior 1.0.38 binary remained available, operator config and user skill survived, and project inspection still found trusted instructions and skills.
grok inspect --json in an isolated trusted Linux project reported one AGENTS.md instruction, 20 skills including AIWG and operator content, and six agents.

aiwg refresh --skip-update --provider grok-build --frameworks sdlc completed in the isolated project and build-verify remained ready.
